# Terms Watch

> Monitor changes to Terms of Service, Privacy Policies, and Community Guidelines across major social media platforms and AI services.

Tracking changes to Terms of Service across major platforms. Data sourced from [Open Terms Archive](https://opentermsarchive.org/), monitoring the [Platform Governance Archive](https://opentermsarchive.org/en/collections/pga/) and [Generative AI Governance Archive](https://opentermsarchive.org/en/collections/genai-eu/) collections. Most detected changes get an AI-generated summary and a diff; newly added or removed documents and unanalyzable changes carry a short standard note instead. The database updates twice daily.

The JSON API below is the best way for agents to read the data: all endpoints are GET and need no authentication. To poll for updates, prefer the edge-cached RSS feed over repeatedly hitting the API.

## API

- [List changes](https://termswatch.io/api/changes): Recent changes, newest first, with summaries but without diffs (each item's `isMinorChange` flags formatting-only edits). Optional query parameters: `category` (`social` or `ai`), `service` (e.g. `TikTok`), `documentType` (e.g. `Privacy Policy`), `days` (only the last N days), `limit` (rows per page, max 200; larger values are silently clamped to 200) and `offset` for pagination, and `includeFormattingOnly=true` to include formatting-only changes (hidden by default). Returns `{ changes, total, limit, offset }`. A single change, including its full diff in the `diffContent` field, is at `https://termswatch.io/api/changes/{id}` using the `id` field from this endpoint.
- [Filter options](https://termswatch.io/api/filter-options): The valid `service` and `documentType` values. `category`, `service`, and `documentType` parameters narrow the other lists (a parameter never narrows its own list). A listed value may have only formatting-only changes, which the list endpoint hides unless `includeFormattingOnly=true`.

## Feeds

- [RSS feed](https://termswatch.io/rss): The 50 most recent substantive changes (formatting-only changes are excluded). Edge-cached — poll this for updates.

## Pages

- [Home](https://termswatch.io/): Filterable timeline of recent changes. Each change also has a shareable page at `https://termswatch.io/change/{commitId}`, where `{commitId}` is the first 8 characters of the change `id`.

## Optional

- [Open Terms Archive](https://opentermsarchive.org/): Upstream source of the tracked documents.
- [Source code](https://github.com/shlomihod/terms-watch): MIT-licensed source for this site.
